source_validation: every fourth policy (index modulo 4 equals 3) held out within each of the two source tasks; encoder, basis and prior fitted on remaining sites only; no source-family generalization claim
encoder: reuse source-aligned two-axis f/g mean and three-axis eta_g/eta_f maps, all from the same declared observable descriptors; default alignment/ridge parameters, no target selection
source_labels: archived observed f,g,eta_g,eta_f; bias-corrected log sample variance; no stored sigma labels
source_solver_rule: same objective and tolerances; raised numerical cap for new coordinate fits, no target-based parameter selection; retain nonconvergence if it occurs
terminal_actions: three 80/128/128 allocation permutations rescaled to remaining cap after reserving 16 comparison calls; or a single policy with 128/all remaining calls; each frozen before independent verification

lookahead_probe.search_points: initial safe, initial incumbent and current posterior primary, distinct; new and repeat use the same one-episode likelihood

execution: saved development paths and raw-fantasy lookahead only, local serial one thread; zero new simulator calls and zero scheduler tasks
truth_use: after all recommendations, terminal allocations and lookahead probes are frozen; conditional expected deployment scoring only, no new independent certificate
scope: three opened seed80 laws, same frozen frontend and 72/73/73 candidate banks; source-site validation and method attribution, not final OR evidence
